jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Strategy and Design: Define network strategy and design IT and OT architecture to meet the needs of the company
• Management and Maintenance: Oversee the company-wide IT network architecture, ensuring its stability and smooth operation
• Deployment and Supervision: Manage deployment projects and supervise wired and wireless networks
• Mobility and Remote Access: Ensure mobile connectivity and remote access to company systems for the entire group, while enabling the use of smart devices
• OT Device Access: Facilitate access to industrial automation equipment (extruders, robots, 3D printers, IoT devices) in close collaboration with the automation department
• Network Security: Manage network security (access and segmentation) under the supervision of the Information Security Manager
• 
Network Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve network issues, optimize performance, monitor traffic, and ensure smooth network operation

 

Education and experience:

• Bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, or a related field
• 3-5 years of experience as a Network Manager
Technical skills:

• Expertise in network technologies (switching, routing, Firewalls, VLANs, SD-WAN, load balancing, NAC, 802.1X, etc.)
• Proficient in network device configuration and troubleshooting
• Experience in network design, remediation, and documentation
• In-depth knowledge of Cisco and Aruba solutions
Language skills:

• Excellent command of English
• Good knowledge of French or German
Personal qualities:

• Customer-oriented
• Proactive and results-driven
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Structured, methodical, and precise work approach
• Willingness to travel up to 35% of the time

What does this job entail? 
 

As Head of Operations, you take full ownership of our operational departments and sites (laboratories and in vivo research facilities), working closely with highly skilled technical experts.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

• You ensure strong alignment between departments and sites, so that processes, priorities and ways of working remain coordinated. 

• You translate the organisation’s strategic objectives into clear operational priorities. 

• You support, coach and challenge department heads in achieving their objectives and strengthening team performance. 

• You foster collaboration and knowledge sharing between teams and disciplines across the organisation. 

• You ensure the efficient use of resources, processes and budgets. 

• You drive operational excellence, with a strong focus on digitalisation and continuous improvement. 

• You ensure quality, compliance and accreditations within operational activities. 

• You monitor operational and financial performance and report on this to management. 

• You identify risks and opportunities across teams and sites.  

You lead multiple teams and sites, taking on a broad leadership role with impact at both operational and strategic levels.

 

• You have 
extensive experience in an operational management role. 

• You are a 
people manager who builds trust, coaches your team to grow, and at the same time maintains progress and momentum. 

• You respond flexibly to changing circumstances and make 
clear decisions. 

• You have experience with 
budgeting and financial follow-up. 

• You have affinity with process improvement, data analysis and 
digitalisation. 

• Experience with 
quality systems, accreditations or audits is a strong asset. 

• You think 
analytically and in a structured way, combined with a clear results-driven approach. 

• You communicate 
fluently in English; any additional language is a plus. 

• You are open to 
international travel.  

Interested in joining our team? 

Send your CV and motivation letter to jobs@poulpharm.be.

Do you enjoy operating a forklift and are you looking for a varied role in a warehouse?

Then we have just the job for you! We are looking for an enthusiastic warehouse assistant for a manufacturing company in the Houthulst area who is keen to get stuck in.

What will you be doing?

  • Loading and unloading lorries.
  • Checking incoming goods and storing them in the correct location.
  • Picking orders and preparing them for dispatch.
  • Monitoring stock levels and carrying out stock records.
  • Carrying out internal transport using the forklift truck.
  • Keeping the warehouse tidy and well-organised.
  • Working together with colleagues from production and logistics.

Who are you?

  • You have experience working in a warehouse environment.
  • You have experience operating a forklift.
  • You hold a valid forklift licence.
  • Knowledge of an ERP system? That’s a bonus!
  • You work safely, accurately and independently.
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English.
  • You’re keen to get stuck in and enjoy a hands-on role.

Our client is a key player in the healthcare and social services sector. The work environment is dynamic, collaborative, and innovation‑driven, with a strong focus on modernizing its IT landscape and continuously improving operational performance. 
They are looking for a Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to join a team responsible for the implementation, maintenance, support, and administration of the network infrastructure.
This includes network hardware, PCs and servers, printers and other peripherals, as well as the core software installed on them, both at the head office and across around one hundred remote sites.

• Implement, maintain, and administer the organization's network infrastructure, including network hardware, servers, PCs, printers, peripherals, and foundational software.
• Support the helpdesk on complex technical issues and provide advanced assistance to end users.
• Monitor system performance, conduct tuning activities, and ensure the stability and reliability of all network and server environments.
• Participate in a 24/7 on‑call rotation to guarantee operational continuity.
• Collaborate with software development teams and intervene on existing applications when needed.
• Mentor and support junior team members, sharing best practices and helping them develop technical skills.
• Analyze technical needs and contribute to the design, documentation, and implementation of new technical solutions.
• Ensure the security, resilience, and scalability of the IT infrastructure across all sites.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and propose improvements to enhance the IT landscape.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.
• Minimum 10 years of proven experience in a similar role with demonstrated progression.
• Valid driving license (Category B).
• You have a good command of technical English and a passive knowledge of Dutch (you can understand Dutch-speaking participants during meetings and work based on documentation written in Dutch).
Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in managing a Windows 11 desktop fleet and related peripherals.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022.
• Good overall knowledge of Linux.
• Strong understanding of LAN/WAN configuration.
• Knowledge of relational databases.
Assets (Nice to Have)

• Experience with Aruba switches.
• Knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise 9, JBoss, Docker.
• Knowledge of PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server.
• Experience with VMware ESX virtualization.
• Basic software development knowledge.
• Experience creating MSI packages and scripting in PHP.
• Knowledge of Office 365 administration.

• Making diagnoses in STAR and MANCATS diagnostic systems.

• Carrying out maintenance orders on trucks

• Dismantling and/or removing certain components

• Performing custom work for specific orders

• Taking care of the customer's vehicle and ensuring customer satisfaction

• You have a higher education in car mechanics or are equivalent through experience.

• You are a team player but can also work independently.

• You always work accurately and solution-oriented and are flexible in function of the customer.

• You have knowledge of general mechanics (or car mechanics), metal (welding) and have basic knowledge of electricity

• You speak English

We are looking for a highly motivated Logistics Operator  for a leading company in the industrial sector. You will be responsible for ensuring smooth internal transport and efficient warehouse management.

 

Your mission;

You will play a crucial role in the efficient and safe processing of goods within the industrial site.

• You select and prepare the correct handling equipment, according to the characteristics of the products and the movement conditions.
• You welcome drivers to the industrial site, collecting and identifying documents from the administrative department.
• You are responsible for unloading or loading trucks.
• You move goods to the storage area and store the received raw materials in their appropriate locations.
• You check the condition of loads, identify anomalies, and pass them on to the relevant department.
• You carry out handling operations using handling equipment (such as forklifts, bulldozers, etc.).
• You ensure the order and cleanliness of the activity.
 

Your profile and skills;

• You are a true team player.
• You are eager to learn and always open to acquiring new skills.
• You are flexible and able to adapt easily to changing circumstances.
• You work in an organized manner and maintain oversight, even in a dynamic environment.
• Working safely comes naturally to you, and you strictly follow procedures.
• Experience with a forklift is a plus, although this is not a strict requirement.
• You have a good command of French and English , allowing you to communicate smoothly in the workplace.

jobs.occupation: Backend Software Engineer | AI & SaaS Sector
jobs.description:
Our partner, an innovative technology company active in the AI and SaaS space, is looking for a Backend Software Engineer to strengthen their engineering team.

Our partner is a fast-growing technology company developing a next-generation digital platform powered by artificial intelligence.

The company is building a modern SaaS solution designed to transform the way businesses operate by combining automation, data and AI-driven technologies.

Operating in an ambitious and innovative environment, the company offers a startup mindset with strong technical challenges, where engineers have a direct impact on the product and its evolution.
Backend Software Engineer | The role :
As a Backend Software Engineer, you will join a highly motivated engineering team and contribute to the development of a scalable AI-driven platform.

You will be responsible for designing, developing and improving backend services, mainly using TypeScript and Node.js.

You will work on core product features, architecture improvements and technical challenges linked to scalability, performance and reliability.

You will also actively participate in product discussions, technical decisions and prioritization sessions, having a real influence on both the technical direction and product evolution.

Backend Software Engineer | The profile :
• You have a Master’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent experience
• You have at least 5 years of experience in backend development
• You have strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript
• You have experience designing scalable backend solutions and APIs
• You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and making pragmatic technical decisions
• Experience with AI-driven applications, prompt engineering or machine learning concepts is a strong plus
• You are curious, proactive and eager to learn new technologies
• You are fluent in Englishand speak Dutch or French

“ 
We make it possible” is not just a slogan, it is our mission. Our growth is driven by our expertise and commitment, within an organization that values diversity and equal opportunities.
 

As part of the development of our activities in Belgium and the Netherlands, we are looking for a Financial Controller/Assistant. You will work closely with the Director of Administration & Development in Belgium and actively contribute to financial monitoring and performance analysis, supporting both local teams and management in Belgium and France.
 

We invest in your professional development and in recognizing your financial expertise. Together, we are building a future of innovation, reliability, and team spirit.
 

Your responsibilities :
 
 

• You will play a key role in the administrative, financial, and analytical follow-up of the company, in close collaboration with the Director of Administration & Development in Belgium and management in France. 

• Ensure administrative and accounting follow-up: validation, booking, and issuance of invoices, optimization of tools (Excel). 

• Participate in monthly closings in collaboration with EY (cut-off of costs and revenues). 

• Manage declarations (VAT and statutory obligations). 

• Organize and monitor payments and cash flow. 

• Perform monthly performance analyses (margins, sites, clients, personnel) and provide reporting to management. 

• Contribute to client invoicing, pricing, and revenue development. 

• Participate in audits, internal control, and continuous process improvement. 

• Monitor depreciation and advise management on financial matters. 

What you bring :
 

- Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related field.
 

- Excellent command of English, French, and Dutch (written and spoken).
 

- Strong Excel skills and interest in financial data analysis.
 

- Analytical mindset, accuracy, and strong organizational skills.
 

- Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with management.

Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you! Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects. You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

• You are able to help set up the architecture for our projects, selecting the right technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

• You are willing to develop yourself and learn new technologies

• You are fluent in English + Dutch or French is a must.

jobs.occupation: Senior Digital Transformation Architect - Transportation sector
jobs.description:
Digital transformation is the cornerstone of Sopra Steria’s commitment to innovation and collaboration. It’s what brings businesses up to the present and secures them for the future. It’s how we align our tech and business goals to keep pace with emerging tech trends and best practices. To do so, you’ll need a forward-thinking, long-view, adaptable mindset to go with your problem solving and analytical skills. Proficiency in cloud computing, data analytics, cybersecurity, and AI skills all help us to collaborate in the business ecosystem to manage digital projects and make adoption of new tech simple and beneficial.

Our Architects have the vision and leadership skills to make daring IT decisions that can make digital transformation a reality. Your ability to collaborate across teams and departments and your flexibility to adopt new technologies will help you enhance system performance, scalability, and security. Fulfil your software vision at Sopra Steria and align it with our business development goals. As a Sopra Steria Architect, you’ll have successful projects in your portfolio that can demonstrate your excellent problem-solving skills and commitment to continuous learning.

Small context :

From the start, you will be immersed in our company culture and way of working, understanding all the capabilities we use to serve our clients in their digital transformation journey. You will work closely with the Sopra Steria teams to provide strategic architectural guidance that helps our transportation clients navigate their transition challenges across the digital themes mentioned above.

Your role as Senior Digital Transformation Architect – Transportation "required" :

• You understand like no other the architectural landscape and digital challenges of our transportation customers. Moreover, you are capable and driven to help them design and implement transformative digital solutions while actively growing our advisory agency.
• You master core business processes in the transportation market and can seamlessly bridge the gap between business needs and technological solutions. You will:
• Design and architect digital transformation initiatives for railway and public transportation operators
• Lead business framing and solution architecture for key digital themes such as: Transformation Consulting, Cybersecurity, Data, Applications & Integrations, Cloud & Infrastructure
• Develop enterprise architecture blueprints that align IT direction with business objectives
• Create and implement innovative architectural strategies to increase our market share in the Transportation sector, with a focus on digital transformation.
• You will be encouraged and expected to bring innovative architectural thinking, challenge the status quo, and drive growth, both with our customers and within Sopra Steria.
 

Your profile as Senior Digital Transformation Architect – Transportation "required" :

• Higher degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• 10+ years of IT architecture experience, with 5+ years in digital transformation for the Transportation sector "REQUIRED".
• Proven track record in large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital themes (Transformation Consulting, Cybersecurity, Data, Applications & Integrations, Cloud & Infrastructure).
• Fluent in French and English – Dutch is a plus
• Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Strategic mindset with the ability to bridge business strategy and technical implementation.
• Passion for innovative technology solutions in transportation.
• 
Entrepreneurial spirit with a focus on growth and business development

The sky’s the limit with cloud computing, so you’ll need to use skills of virtualization, containerization, and orchestration using tools like Kubernetes and Docker to design, deploy, and manage cloud-based solutions. We pride ourselves on our secure, compliant, efficient and well-optimized cloud solutions. You’ll feel at home working with cloud-native development, serverless architectures, and DevOps practices. To take cloud adoption to its fullest extent, you’ll use your analytical and governance skills, problem-solving abilities, and cross-functional team collaboration to drive innovation and efficiency in cloud environments.

Keeping our systems running smoothly and optimally will be your ultimate goal as our (Cloud) System Engineer. Your days will consist of automating and maintaining our systems as well as developing scripts that optimize our infrastructure and align cloud systems to always serve our business goals. You’ll use your expertise in cloud platforms (Azure & AWS), automation frameworks, containerization, virtualization, networking, and security practices to drive digital transformation. Our goal is to build reliable and cost-efficient systems. As a (Cloud) System Engineer, you’ll make it happen by designing, implementing, and supporting scalable cloud environments, streamlining deployment processes and reducing manual interventions.

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent
• 5 years of experience in infrastructure projects
• Eperience with cloud services such as Microsoft Azure, AzureAD, EMS, Office365, AWS etc.
• Broad knowledge of networking, system and information architectures, storage concepts, virtualization, containers, automation, Microsoft Azure, Office 365, security and management
• Scripting and automation: Powershell, VBSript, Bash, Ansible etc.
• Experience with methodologies such as project management, ITIL, etc. or are willing to get certified
• Fluent in English and Dutch/French

As an AI Engineer, you bring traditional and Generative AI into real world use cases by helping our clients design, build, and serve Generative AI solutions. You design and implement solutions that require from traditional AI to LLMs, from semantic search to conversational AI. You train, fine-tune, improve, and deploy ML models. Furthermore, you write production ready code to serve online, batch, and real time models. You build applications and software to serve AI driven use cases.  

You work in close collaboration with Data Scientists, MLOps Engineers and Data Engineers, to integrate all parts of the solution. You help build solutions and/or operate with our clients on a medium to long-term basis. 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in AI consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. You will be part of the Data & AI team, where we tackle AI challenges end to end, from strategy, governance, to science and engineering. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

 

 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

• At least 3 years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, MLOps Engineer, or in a similar position 
• Experience with traditional NLP, LLMs, and conversational AI, both in experimentation phase and in production 
• Experience with vector databases for semantic search and RAG solutions in a production environment. 
• Strong software engineering background and ability to write production ready code in Python 
• Experience with experiment tracking, models monitoring, LLM and NLP evaluation techniques, and deployment strategies 
• Comfortable with the machine learning lifecycle and MLOps and DevOps principles 
• Experience with at least one cloud provider and good knowledge of the data ecosystem 
• Able to coach others, give technical advice and direction, and work independently 
• Master or PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, or related field. 
• Proficient in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus.

Description

• Strategy: Developing and implementing IT strategies for the assigned area
• Management: Supervising teams, managing projects and optimising the use of resources.
• Technology: Evaluate and integrate relevant IT tools and infrastructures.
• Partnerships: Working with internal and external stakeholders.
• Solutions: Design and deploy IT solutions that meet the company's needs.

Profile

• Degree in IT or related field.
• 5 to 15 years' experience in IT project management.
• Proficiency in relevant operating systems and programming languages (Windows, VMWare, SAP, C#, .NET, SQL).
• Excellent communication skills (English, French or Dutch).
• Ability to solve problems and lead teams.
• 
Results-oriented and stress-resistant.

Role
As a Data Architect, you will work for our client to design, manage, and optimize complex data structures and systems. You will define data strategies aligned with the organization’s vision, ensure data integrity and scalability, and establish standards for data governance. You translate stakeholder needs into technical solutions and provide clear documentation so that each stakeholder can understand the data model from their perspective. You embrace innovation by implementing new technologies and data analytics tools, always in compliance with applicable regulations.

 

Profile
• At least 3 years of experience as a data architect

• Experience with Data Lake, Governance and Management
• Strong communication skills, both independently and in a team setting
• Familiar with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Lean)

• Analytical mindset, solution-oriented, and eager to keep up with industry trends
• 
Able to coach junior and medior data architects and collaborate across teams
